pages.title: What it does
pages.text: Highlights nearby creatures and storages (chests, barrels, shulker boxes, ender chests and containers from other mods), allowing you to see them through walls and other obstacles.$(br2)$(bold)$(#7952A6)Requirement:$() Path level 5.

pages.title: Use and limits
pages.text: Use Spirit Sense to scout a dangerous room or detect creatures hiding nearby. It does not damage or stop its targets.

pages.title: Trail to the Soul Shard
pages.text: While Sense is on and your Soul Shard lies where you died, a trail of dark smoke leads to it. The trail points to the shard itself, not to the place of death, so it finds the shard even behind a wall. It fades when you get close. With the Crown of the Beyond on, creatures you look at show health and effects in a subdued panel.
